description: This file defines the SmsHandler class responsible for managing SMS sending and searching within an Android app. It interacts with an SmsManager to perform operations and returns standardized results via the GatewaySession.InvokeResult class.

classes.name: SmsHandler
classes.description: A class to handle SMS sending and searching, encapsulating interactions with an SmsManager and returning standardized invoke results.

methods.name: handleSmsSend
methods.description: Sends an SMS message using the provided JSON parameters and returns the result wrapped in GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: handleSmsSearch
methods.description: Performs an SMS search with the given JSON parameters and returns the result wrapped in GatewaySession.InvokeResult.

methods.name: errorResult
methods.description: Constructs an error result, parsing error message to extract a code and message for logging and handling purposes.
